questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code chooses and configures notification delivery for each environment? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A new container is deployed with no APP_ENV variable at all. What does SenderFactory.create do?
choices: Returns a LoggingSender, since local is the safest mode
Returns a production ProviderSender, assuming the NOTIFY_API_KEY is present
Throws IllegalStateException before any sender is built
Returns an AllowListSender with an empty allow list

questions.prompt: In STAGING with NOTIFY_ALLOW_LIST=qa@example.com, the application sends a notification to customer@example.org. What is the observable result?
choices: send() returns normally, nothing is delivered, and an info log line with the subject is written
send() throws an exception that the caller must handle
The message is delivered through the sandbox provider anyway, because it is not production
The message is delivered to qa@example.com instead

questions.prompt: In PRODUCTION the process is started with NOTIFY_ALLOW_LIST=qa@example.com and a valid NOTIFY_API_KEY. How are notifications handled?
choices: Only qa@example.com receives notifications; others are suppressed
Startup fails because an allow list is not permitted in production
The allow list is used only when the recipient domain is example.com
The allow list is ignored and notifications go to any recipient through the production provider
